definitions.gloss: driving force; propulsive power (of engine, motor, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The mechanical force that drives or propels a machine, vehicle, or device forward. Used in engineering and automotive contexts.
The force, motivation, or factor that drives progress, change, or achievement in an abstract sense. Used figuratively in business, social, and personal contexts.
